create.title: Complete-symbol carrier cancellation and metric-parity self-return
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt X, retain the complete collar-extracted top-M2 coefficient B^circ_(a,b,k)(g), and put theta=Lambda/k=X(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/(2k), q=(b-a)/2. Define C^circ=e(-g theta/2)B^circ. Then exactly C^circ=g int_(b/4)^a A^circ_(ga,gb)(gu)e(g[ku-J(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))sqrt(u)])du. If theta=ell+eta, p=ell k, and g is odd, then (-1)^(q+ell)B^circ(g)e(-g eta/2)=(-1)^q C^circ(g); hence the quotient sign (-1)^(p/k) cancels pointwise against the carrier inside the complete actual symbol. For a period-one strict-metric window W_R(t)=mu_R+sum_(r!=0) W_hat_R(r)e(rt), the complete-symbol expansion has integer modes mu_R C^circ+sum_(r!=0)W_hat_R(r)e(r theta)C^circ, so the literal r=0 density mode returns. Under h=ga, s=gb, x=gu, C^circ=int_(s/4)^h A^circ_(h,s)(x)e(kx-J(sqrt(s)-sqrt(h))sqrt(x))dx and (-1)^q=chi_4(h)chi_4(s), giving an exact adjoint-Poisson return to the residual transposed two-character energy. Therefore quotient parity, a half-integer Fourier gap, discrepancy-only bounds, or another reciprocal re-enumeration supply no independent saving. The residual complete-coefficient signed cross-row correlation remains open, and no hard subrange, M9-M2 estimate, or exponent follows.
